method: read-only byte inspection of persisted packages; presence of an object path implies a serialized reference, absence of any material path implies no interface is bound
finding: Each imported building mesh declares two material slots named MAT_0 and MAT_1 (FBX slot names) but no material interface is bound to either. No MAT_N_M, no /Game/Carla material, and no fallback material path appears in any sampled package.
consequence: Buildings will render with the engine default surface material. This is a VISUAL QUALITY defect, not a cook blocker: cooking a StaticMesh with unbound material interfaces succeeds and substitutes a default at render time.
